quotes.text: I don't care how far behind I am. I don't care how many times I fall. I don't care how impossible it looks. I will keep moving forward. I will surpass my limits.

source.title: Instagram
source.citation: Unattributed Instagram post; original post URL unavailable

quotes.notes: The author and original publication are unknown. See issue #6.

quotes.text: Surpass your limits. Right here. Right now.

source.title: Black Clover
source.citation: Episode 44, The Pointlessly Direct Fireball and the Wild Lightning, approximately 10:40

quotes.notes: The archived Crunchyroll subtitle begins with 'All of you.' The shorter wording is commonly quoted; confirm against an official licensed release before marking verified.

quotes.text: If you don't fight, you can't win.

source.citation: Season 1, Episode 6, The World the Girl Saw: The Battle for Trost, Part 2, approximately 17:46

quotes.text: Talent is something you make bloom. Instinct is something you polish.

quotes.text: You have no enemies. No one has any enemies.

quotes.text: A lesson without pain is meaningless.
